title: Billing and Coding: Biomarker Testing for Prostate Cancer Diagnosis

codes.1: The CPT codes in Group 1 are considered medically necessary when ordered by a physician or other qualified health care professional (i.e., NP, CNS, PA). 4K Score should be billed with 81539 PCA3 should be billed using code 81313 ConfirmDx should be billed using code 81551 %fPSA should be billed using codes 84153 and 84154. PHI should be billed using codes 84153, 84154 and 86316. SelectMDX should be billed using code 81479 EPI should be billed using code 0005U.
